exposure: Fresh cord blood transplantation (F-CBT) from an HLA-matched sibling donor
cohort: The study included 68 pediatric patients with beta-thalassaemia major who underwent fresh cord blood transplantation from an HLA-matched sibling donor between June 2010 and July 2018.
finding: Patients with beta-thalassaemia major who underwent fresh cord blood transplantation from an HLA-matched sibling donor showed excellent outcomes with high survival rates and low incidence of acute and chronic graft-versus-host disease.
